purpose: Dated, sourced facts about the current status of a provision that its codified text does not carry. A note is appended, verbatim, to a delivered answer that cites a matching source (fix S1, regulus.rag.status_notes); it is never paraphrased by the model.

notes.text: Status note (FDA, checked 23 Oct 2026): this registration or filing belongs to FDA's Voluntary Cosmetic Registration Program, which FDA stopped accepting and processing submissions to on 27 March 2023, as it built the facility registration and product listing program the Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act of 2022 requires.
Status note (eCFR, checked 23 Oct 2026): 21 CFR 740.18 was stayed until further notice, effective Sept. 18, 1980 (47 FR 7829, Feb. 23, 1982), so its warning requirement is not in effect.

Status note (Federal Register, checked 23 Oct 2026): FD&C Act § 606 directs FDA to issue good manufacturing practice regulations for cosmetic facilities; FDA has published no proposed or final rule under it (the only Federal Register document is the April 2023 listening-session notice, 2023-08942).

notes.text: Status note (Federal Register, checked 26 Oct 2026): part 820 was amended by the final rule "Medical Devices; Quality System Regulation Amendments" (89 FR 7496, 2 Feb 2024, Federal Register document 2024-01709), which took effect on 2 February 2026. The amended part incorporates ISO 13485:2016 by reference (21 CFR 820.7), and Subparts C through O of the former Quality System regulation were removed and reserved.
